flow.zh: 初春四月，遊日本本州能登半島，一日午后，乘坐火車自和倉溫泉北上穴水，參訪來迎寺。穴水小鎮市街安靜，有學童零散回家，宅急便專車駛過。梅花雖已展開，櫻樹卻剛自春日蘇醒，樹枝平淡，偶而有櫻花枝條，隨風搖曳。
flow.en: In early spring, in April, traveling the Noto Peninsula of Honshu, Japan, one afternoon I took a train north from Wakura Onsen to Anamizu, to visit Raikō-ji Temple. The streets of the small town of Anamizu were quiet, with a few schoolchildren scattered on their way home, and a Takkyubin delivery truck passing by. Though the plum blossoms had already opened, the cherry trees had only just stirred from their spring slumber, their branches plain and bare, save for an occasional cherry branch swaying in the wind.

zh: 箱根蘆之湖傍的紅色鳥居
摩洛哥撤哈拉沙漠的星空
梵谷畫裡橘黃的咖啡夜店
台南一中紅樓教室的走廊
羅大佑的歌“光隂的故事＂
古時女媧煉石補天的神話
達爾文物種起源的進化理論
聖經創世紀上帝運行的靈氣
基隆河上游濕潤的十分瀑布
南唐李後主《浪淘沙》詞句
en: The quiet of the city streets makes me recall
The red torii by Lake Ashi in Hakone
The reflection of the torii gate reminds me
The night after the mist clears over Sun Moon Lake
A clear, still night reminds me
The starry sky over Morocco's Sahara Desert
A dreamlike starry sky makes me recall
The orange-yellow café at night in Van Gogh's painting
The wine-like aroma of coffee makes me recall
The bell of the church at Obidos, Portugal
The lingering toll of the bell reminds me
The corridor of the Red Building classrooms at Tainan First Senior High
The corridor's wall poster brings to mind
Luo Dayou's song 'The Story of Time'
The color of the story makes me recall
The ancient myth of Nüwa smelting stones to mend the sky
The shifting currents of myth bring to mind
Darwin's theory of evolution from the Origin of Species
The ambiguity of theory reminds me
The Spirit of God moving, as in Genesis
The flow of its spirit reminds me
Sedona's strange red rocks in the open wilderness
The drought of red rock brings to mind
The moist Shifen Falls upstream on the Keelung River
The waterfall like a curtain brings to mind
Lines from Li Yu of the Southern Tang's "Waves Scouring Sand"
Beyond the curtain rain murmurs on, spring's ardor fading----
Spring's mood fading
It is an impression of Laiying Temple
Standing still by the bridge over the stream
Watching the grass's color, the shimmering light
There are a few branches of cherry blossom
Reflecting the slanting sun

points.zh: 蘆之湖是日本箱根國家公園内最大的湖，三千年前形成的火山湖。四面環山，水色清澈，有渡輪型似海盗船，靠岸港口箱根町港一帶，可遙望富士山。附近有箱根神社立於湖畔，蒼齡杉樹林立，蔽天綠䕃中隱藏古刹寺院，靜穆中浸淫着佛思禪意。臨湖的紅色鳥居，掩映着長空秋色，隔水遠望，自有一份出塵離世的澄寂。
points.en: Lake Ashi is the largest lake in Japan's Hakone National Park, a volcanic lake formed three thousand years ago. Surrounded on all sides by mountains, its waters are clear, and ferries shaped like pirate ships cross it; from the shore near Hakone-machi port one can gaze out at Mt. Fuji in the distance. Nearby, Hakone Shrine stands at the lake's edge, ringed by ancient cedar groves, and hidden within the sky-shading green shade is an old temple, its stillness steeped in Buddhist and Zen contemplation. The red torii gate by the lake, set against the autumn colors of the vast sky, viewed from across the water, carries a serene, otherworldly stillness.

points.zh: 《夜晚露天咖啡座》(The Café Terrace on the Place du Forum) 是梵谷的著名作品之一。這是梵谷第一幅有星空背景的畫作，其他有星空背景的畫作有《隆河上的星夜》，《星夜》等。這幅畫有梵谷獨特的暖色調和透視法。黃色咖啡座的光暈和藍色星空的深邃，形成有趣的對比，天空，星星，燈光和人影，相互輝映，讓夜晚的氛圍更加神秘迷離。梵谷試圖利用感性筆觸和豊富色彩，來發抒主觀感情和自我感受，表達其內心的孤寂和渴望人群的關懷。整幅畫散放著柔美的詩意，也醞釀著浮昇的生命力。
points.en: "The Café Terrace on the Place du Forum" (The Café Terrace on the Place du Forum) is one of Van Gogh's famous works. This is Van Gogh's first painting with a starry-sky background; his other paintings with starry backgrounds include "Starry Night Over the Rhône" and "The Starry Night." This painting displays Van Gogh's distinctive warm color tones and use of perspective. The glow of the yellow café and the deep blue of the starry sky form an interesting contrast; the sky, the stars, the lights, and the human figures play off one another, making the night's atmosphere all the more mysterious and enchanting. Van Gogh sought, through emotive brushwork and rich color, to express his subjective feelings and inner experience, conveying his inner loneliness and his longing for human companionship. The whole painting radiates a soft, poetic quality while also brewing a rising vitality.

points.zh: Obidos，濱臨大西洋的葡萄牙古城，位於首都里斯本北方約九十公里。是迷失在時代𥚃的古城，是石塊堆砌城牆環繞中的一片寧靜世界，有「山谷中的珍珠」的美譽。高大城牆中的小城，摒絶市井車馬喧嘩，散放著中世紀的古風古調，童話般的清純迷幻。鵝卵石街巷蜿蜒交織，曲徑短牆繁花點綴。兩側錯落有致的房舍，以白牆紅瓦，海水般的藍和大地的土黃，構成小城的主色調，予人一份自然，純樸，簡約的悠閒和愉悅。漫步其間，隨心流覽，藝品店的巧思，牆面的彩色擺置，典雅的街燈，加上巧克力和咖啡的酒香，自有一番遺世獨立的淡然心情。巷弄清幽而雋永，時有詩意和美學悄然迎面而來。Santa Maria 敎堂的白色牆面和鐘塔，巴洛克的雕飾，流散著古典的婉約幽雅。古城地形起伏，彎曲小路，像一節美的旋律，漫延至山嶺和城垣。登臨城牆，放眼四望，一邊是屋舍紅瓦平排，葡萄園青濛連天而去，另一邊是城牆婉轉并列，沒入雨烟如史册沉寂。徘徊蹀踱，不覺有 "行到水窮處，坐看雲起時" 的自足閒適。
points.en: Obidos, an ancient Portuguese town on the Atlantic coast, is located about ninety kilometers north of the capital, Lisbon. It is an ancient town lost in time, a tranquil world enclosed by stone walls, known as the 'Pearl in the Valley.' The small town within its tall walls is set apart from the noise and bustle of everyday life, giving off an old medieval air and a fairy-tale-like purity and enchantment. Its cobblestone lanes wind and intertwine, with winding paths and low walls dotted with flowers. The houses on either side, arranged with pleasing irregularity, combine white walls and red roof tiles with sea-like blue and earthy ochre to form the town's dominant palette, lending a sense of natural, simple, unhurried ease and pleasure. Wandering through at will, one takes in the ingenious little craft shops, the colorful arrangements on the walls, the elegant street lamps, and the fragrance of chocolate and coffee liqueur, all evoking a quiet, detached contentment. The alleys are secluded and enduring, with poetry and beauty quietly appearing at every turn. The white walls and bell tower of the Church of Santa Maria, with their Baroque ornamentation, exude classical grace and refinement. The old town's terrain rises and falls, its winding paths like a beautiful melody extending up into the hills and along the town walls. Climbing the walls and looking out in every direction, on one side rows of red-tiled roofs stretch out with vineyards fading into a hazy green horizon, while on the other side the town walls curve away in parallel lines, disappearing into misty rain as quietly as a page from history. Wandering back and forth here, one feels, without quite noticing it, the contented ease of 'walking to where the water ends, then sitting to watch the clouds rise.'

points.zh: 羅大佑的歌:《光隂的故事》。「發黃的相片，古老的信，以及褪色的聖誕卡。 年輕時為你寫的歌，恐怕你早已忘了吧。 過去的誓言，就像那課本裡，繽紛的書籤。刻劃著多少美麗的詩，可是終究是一陣煙。流水它帶走，光陰的故事，改變了兩個人。就在那多愁善感，而初次流淚的青春。」
points.en: Luo Dayou's song, "The Story of Time" (光陰的故事): "Yellowed photographs, old letters, and faded Christmas cards. The songs I wrote for you when young — I'm afraid you've long forgotten them. Past vows, like the colorful bookmarks tucked in that textbook, inscribed with so many beautiful poems, yet in the end just a wisp of smoke. The flowing water carries away the story of time, and changes two people. It happened in that sentimental youth, the first time tears were shed."

points.zh: 舊約聖經創世紀第一章 : 「起初，神創造天地。地是空虛混沌，淵面黑暗，神的靈運行在水面上。神說 : 要有光，就有了光。」
points.en: Old Testament, Genesis, Chapter 1: "In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth. The earth was without form and void, and darkness was over the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God was hovering over the face of the waters. And God said, 'Let there be light,' and there was light."

points.zh: Sedona位於美國亞利桑納州內，是神秘紅岩靈氣之鄉。境內有無數美麗，造形奇幻的紅色岩石，一層又一層紅色山脈，壯麗景象令人驚艶。這裡也是世界數一數二，擁有巨大磁場能量的地方。印地安人傳說，Sedona 是可以直通聖靈之處。許多宗教團体在這裡設立據點，是靈修的聖地。有傳言: 上帝創造了大峽谷，自己卻住在Sedona。
points.en: Sedona is located in the state of Arizona in the United States, known as a mysterious land of red rocks and spiritual energy. It contains countless beautiful, fantastically shaped red rock formations and layer upon layer of red mountain ranges, a magnificent sight. It is also said to be one of the places on earth with the greatest concentration of magnetic field energy. According to Native American legend, Sedona is a place that leads directly to the spirit world. Many religious groups have established centers here, making it a sacred site for spiritual practice. There is a saying: God created the Grand Canyon, but chose to live in Sedona.

points.zh: 基隆河上游由於切割和侵蝕作用，造成許多斷層和奇岩，是屬於瀑布溪谷地形，大小瀑布接二連三，形成瀑布群。其中位於平溪附近的十分瀑布爲著名景點。十分瀑布寬度約40公尺，落差約20公尺，是台湾最大的簾幕型瀑布。水瀑壯麗，氣勢磅礡，瀑布下方水潭極深，水霧長年瀰漫不散，一經陽光照射，可見清麗彩虹橫列其上。瀑布的外層岩走向和水流方向相反，屬逆斜層瀑布，地質結構和北美洲的尼加拉瀑布相似，故有“台湾尼加拉瀑布“ 的美譽。
points.en: Due to erosion and faulting, the upper reaches of the Keelung River have formed many faults and unusual rock formations, characteristic of waterfall-valley terrain, with large and small waterfalls occurring one after another to form a cluster of falls. Among them, the Shifen Waterfall near Pingxi is a famous scenic spot. Shifen Waterfall is about 40 meters wide with a drop of about 20 meters, making it Taiwan's largest curtain-type waterfall. The waterfall is magnificent and powerful; the pool beneath it is extremely deep, and mist lingers over it year-round — when struck by sunlight, a bright, clear rainbow can be seen spanning across it. The outer rock strata of the waterfall run opposite to the direction of the water flow, making it a reverse-dip waterfall; its geological structure is similar to that of Niagara Falls in North America, earning it the nickname "Taiwan's Niagara Falls."

points.zh: 李後主的《浪淘沙》:「簾外雨潺潺，春意闌珊，羅衾不耐五更寒。夢裡不知身是客，一响貪歡。獨自莫憑樓，無限江山，別時容易見時難。流水落花春去也，天上人間。」蔣勲在他的《感覺宋詞》一書中評說，這首浪淘沙是李後主成就最高的作品，是美學的極品。詞裡凝結了李後主亡國後的情感，以及由亡國情感擴大而成爲對生命繁華與幻滅之間的深沉領悟。
points.en: Li Houzhu's 'Waves Scouring the Sand': "Outside the curtain the rain patters on, spring's glory is fading; the silk quilt cannot keep out the chill of the fifth watch. In my dream I did not know myself a guest, greedily seeking pleasure for one brief moment. Alone, do not lean upon the balcony rail, for boundless rivers and mountains lie beyond — parting was easy, but meeting again is hard. The flowing water, the fallen blossoms, spring has gone away — as different as heaven from the human world." Chiang Hsun, in his book 'Sensing the Ci-Poetry of the Song Dynasty,' comments that this 'Waves Scouring the Sand' is Li Houzhu's finest achievement, the very pinnacle of aesthetic art. The ci-poem crystallizes Li Houzhu's emotions after the fall of his kingdom, and expands from the feeling of a fallen nation into a profound realization about the splendor and impermanence of life.
